I added `waitingFor(ref)` to `Outbox`, just above `forBooking`. It filters to that booking's `queued` and `failed` notices. `filter` builds a new array, so sorting it by `dueAt` and then `id` leaves the outbox's own order alone. The notices themselves are not touched, and an unknown reference gives `[]`.

I couldn't see the file body, so I anchored the edit on the `forBooking(ref: string): Notice[] {` line from the outline. If that line differs in the real file, the edit will be refused. I also wrote the state check inline rather than using `isWaiting`, since I couldn't confirm which states it accepts.
